title: Remove a specified loss from a theorem in the base paper
statement: For every admissible object, prove or refute the exact improved estimate.
objective: Remove exactly the stated loss while preserving all quantifiers and uniformity.
hypotheses_and_domains: List every domain, hypothesis, endpoint, and coefficient field here.
uniformity_and_endpoints: The constant is independent of all problem data and degeneracies listed by the owner.
exclusions_and_statement_drift: Do not replace the target by a weaker loss, a special case, or a bounded-parameter result.
proof_success: A complete deductive proof of the exact statement, including every limiting step.
refutation_success: An exact counterexample or rigorous unbounded sequence violating the target.
base_source_references: arXiv identifier, title, version, or local paper path
literature_instructions: Extract exact theorem statements, hypotheses, route mechanisms, limitations, and the unresolved bridge.
